test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, select the number that will be on the face opposite the face showing the number '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3441250a6f075a36bbc9c278f4ec67b12f843ea4027371fa0afcaa58299d032.png]
solution:
In this question, We will use the opposite face relation of cube which is shown below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3923363d8cb263bb9d5cab2b8d84e9733869778590d13b0690b68523ec6be3d3.png] 

The opposite faces are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e4616d20fbe652ceccfe8045bf2a770134a52f3b6585489f2b9a0bc977d8b00.png] 

Hence, **2 **is the number that will be on the opposite the face showing the number '4'.
